entities.name: UniProt Q2RZX7
observations: Reviewed Salinibacter ruber catalase-peroxidase; query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match.
Bifunctional heme-b enzyme with catalase and broad-spectrum peroxidase activities; EC 1.11.1.21.
Reference annotation reports one heme-b group per dimer.

entities.name: Catalase RHEA:20309
observations: 2 H2O2 → O2 + 2 H2O; catalase activity of the matched enzyme.

entities.name: Peroxidase RHEA:30275
observations: H2O2 + AH2 → A + 2 H2O; broad-spectrum peroxidase reaction, where AH2 is a reducing donor.
A represents the oxidized donor; specific substrate is not established by the sequence match alone.
